BriefDes[1]: When Basic Attacks hit marked enemies, there is a chance to trigger <color=#FF6347>Lightning Lure</color> and deal Lightning DMG. Pinging Red Orbs also has a chance to trigger <color=#FF6347>Lightning Lure</color>. After triggering <color=#FF6347>Lightning Lure</color> for <color=#FF6347>4</color> times, the next <color=#FF6347>Lightning Lure</color> will summon <color=#FF6347>EX Lightning Lure</color>, dealing Lightning DMG and healing allies in the area.
SpecificDes[1]:
When Basic Attacks hit marked enemies, there is a chance to trigger <color=#FF6347>Lightning Lure</color> and deal Lightning DMG. Pinging Red Orbs also has a chance to trigger <color=#FF6347>Lightning Lure</color>. After triggering <color=#FF6347>Lightning Lure</color> for <color=#FF6347>4</color> times, the next <color=#FF6347>Lightning Lure</color> will summon <color=#FF6347>EX Lightning Lure</color>, dealing Lightning DMG and healing allies in the area.
- Basic Attacks have a <color=#FF6347>30%</color> chance to trigger <color=#FF6347>Lightning Lure</color> when they hit marked enemies.
- Pinging Red Orbs has a <color=#FF6347>30/60/100%</color> chance to trigger <color=#FF6347>Lightning Lure</color> based on the number of orbs pinged.
- <color=#FF6347>Lightning Lure</color> deals <color=#FF6347>90%</color> Lightning DMG.
- <color=#FF6347>EX Lightning Lure</color> deals <color=#FF6347>300%</color> Lightning DMG and heals allies in the area for <color=#FF6347>60%</color> of Lux's ATK each time.

Name: Field Supplies
Title[1]: Core Passive: <color=#0d70bc>Last hit of Basic Attack/Any 3-Ping/Cast Signature Move/Cast QTE + Pick up Energy Ball</color>
BriefDes[1]: Sophia: Silverfang drops an Energy Ball after any of the following: the last hit of Basic Attack, dealing damage with a 3-Ping skill, casting Signature Move, or casting QTE. Picking up an Energy Ball heals all the allies within range and grants <color=#FF6347>Fire Tempered</color>, increasing Fire DMG. Whenever an Energy Ball is picked up, Sophia: Silverfang gains Energy and Heat. Her ATK increases based on the current Heat.
SpecificDes[1]:
Sophia: Silverfang drops an Energy Ball after any of the following: the last hit of Basic Attack, dealing damage with a 3-Ping skill, casting Signature Move, or casting QTE. Picking up an Energy Ball heals all the allies within range and grants <color=#FF6347>Fire Tempered</color>, increasing Fire DMG. Whenever an Energy Ball is picked up, Sophia: Silverfang gains Energy and Heat. Her ATK increases based on the current Heat.
- Picking up an Energy Ball heals all allies within range for HP equal to <color=#FF6347>10%</color> of Sophia: Silverfang's ATK.
- <color=#FF6347>Fire Tempered</color> increases the Fire DMG of the character who picked up the Energy Ball by <color=#FF6347>5%</color> for <color=#FF6347>5</color>s.
- Whenever an Energy Ball is picked up, Sophia: Silverfang gains <color=#FF6347>4</color> Energy and <color=#FF6347>75</color> Heat.
- Sophia: Silverfang's ATK increases by <color=#FF6347>5/10/15%</color> when her Heat is over <color=#FF6347>0/100/200</color>.

BriefDes[1]: Signature Move: Once <color=#FF6347>POD: Shield</color> is fully charged, unleashes <color=#FF6347>Berserk Mode</color> to grant A2 Super Armor and increase her Extra DMG Reduction, movement speed, and Extra DMG Bonus. <color=#FF6347>Berserk Mode</color> will consume max HP every second (prioritizing <color=#FF6347>POD: Shield</color> if <color=#FF6347>POD: Shield</color> is present). <color=#FF6347>Berserk Mode</color> can be deactivated manually or will automatically deactivate once A2's current HP falls to a certain level. Once deactivated, it cannot be activated again for a certain duration. If A2 leaves the field while <color=#FF6347>Berserk Mode</color> is active, <color=#FF6347>POD: Shield</color> will continue to diminish until fully depleted. While A2 is on standby, <color=#FF6347>Berserk Mode</color> will deactivate if <color=#FF6347>POD: Shield</color> is fully depleted.

Switching to another character will consume all Annihilation Pts. Exiting <color=#FF6347>Annihilation State</color> will rearrange the Signal Orbs into 3-Pings.

When there are a certain amount of Annihilation Pts, press and hold the Basic Attack button to enter <color=#FF6347>Annihilation State</color>, deal AOE Dark DMG, hide the original Signal Orbs, and gain <color=#FF6347>Annihilation Orbs</color> based on the current Annihilation Pts. When this skill is cast, Luna will become invincible, and QTEs not in cooldown will be activated. In <color=#FF6347>Annihilation State</color>, entering the Matrix will grant <color=#FF6347>1</color> <color=#FF6347>Annihilation Orb</color>, launching Basic Attacks will consume Annihilation Pts. When the Annihilation Pts drop to <color=#FF6347>0</color> or when another character is switched in, Luna will exit <color=#FF6347>Annihilation State</color>. Switching to another character will consume all Annihilation Pts. Exiting <color=#FF6347>Annihilation State</color> will rearrange the Signal Orbs into 3-Pings.
- Every 3-Ping grants <color=#FF6347>15</color> Annihilation Pts, up to <color=#FF6347>60</color>.
- When there are at least 15 Annihilation Pts, press and hold the Basic Attack button to enter <color=#FF6347>Annihilation State</color> and deal <color=#FF6347>300%</color> AOE Dark DMG.
- Gains up to <color=#FF6347>4</color> <color=#FF6347>Annihilation Orbs</color> based on the current Annihilation Pts.
- Every Basic Attack will consume <color=#FF6347>5</color> Annihilation Pts.

Upon reaching a certain level of <color=#FF6347>Shadow Prism Energy</color>, the next Basic Attack will empty all <color=#FF6347>Shadow Prism Energy</color> to cast a <color=#FF6347>Shadow Prism Attack</color> and create <color=#FF6347>1</color> Twilight Matrix on the target's location that deals Dark DMG and knocks the target down. When generated, the Twilight Matrix grants No.21: XXI Signature Energy and Dodge Energy.

Name: Shadow Prism Agglomerate
WeaponSkillDes: Wide-Energy Pressure Core: Whenever No. 21: XXI performs Shadow Prism attacks, a QTE, or disrupts incoming enemy attacks, the Co-Bot unleashes a <color=#FF6347>Force Wave</color> that deals <color=#FF6347>50%</color> AOE Dark DMG to enemies (only triggers once per second). Energy Suppression Unit: Hitting allies with Force Wave will grant them <color=#FF6347>Energy Suppression</color> for 3s. Energy Suppression: Dark DMG reduces the enemy's healing received by <color=#FF6347>100%</color> for 3s. Impulse Fort Module: When the Force Wave detonates <color=#FF6347>6</color> Twilight Matrices at once, the Co-Bot enters Fortification mode, unleashing a hyper-pulse that deals Dark DMG equal to <color=#FF6347>447.06%</color> of No. 21: XXI's ATK (DMG scales with Core Passive level). Inver-Resonance Unit 2.0: Increases the Extra DMG Bonus of No. 21: XXI's Twilight Matrix and <color=#FF6347>Resonance Pulse</color> by <color=#FF6347>15%</color>.

Name: Art of Deception
BriefDes[1]: The Basic Attack combo DMG ratio is adjusted. Gains <color=#FF6347>Deception Points</color> based on the combo type upon triggering <color=#FF6347>valid combos</color>. Roland's Red/Yellow/Blue Orbs are unlocked when there are a certain amount of <color=#FF6347>Deception Points</color>. Each time the 1st or 2nd hit of a Signal Orb skill is cast, <color=#FF6347>Deception Points</color> will be consumed to generate Energy. The combos of Basic Attacks and Signal Orb skills can be viewed in the description of each skill. <color=#FF6347>Valid combos</color>: The Basic Attack combo launched within 1s after dealing DMG from Basic Attacks. Upon triggering Matrix, the next Signal Orb skill cast does not consume any <color=#FF6347>Deception Points</color> or <color=#FF6347>Trickery Points</color>. Roland cannot gain Signal Orbs from Basic Attacks. When he is switched off battle, he gains <color=#FF6347>Deception Points</color>. Signal Orbs gained from any other source would be directly converted into <color=#FF6347>Deception Points</color> or Energy, prioritizing <color=#FF6347>Deception Points</color>.

Name: Ode for Everlight
BriefDes[1]: Basic Attacks and pinging orbs accumulate Prayer. When it is full, <color=#FF6347>double tapping</color> the Dodge button triggers <color=#FF6347>Divine Prayer</color> that grants DMG Reduction. While in Divine Prayer, it is allowed to ping 2 sets of orbs. The orbs pinged during the prayer will amplify it and increase the base multiplier. Each time orbs are pinged, triggers <color=#FF6347>Prayer Ripple</color> that deals Fire DMG to enemies, imprisons them, and heals allies. When <color=#FF6347>Core Passive - Ode for Everlight</color> reaches Lv.22, entering <color=#FF6347>Divine Prayer</color> will grant <color=#FF6347>1</color> random Signal Orb, and casting Oaths will restore Dodge Energy.

Each time orbs are pinged, triggers <color=#FF6347>Prayer Ripple</color> that deals Fire DMG to enemies, imprisons them, and heals allies. When it is full, <color=#FF6347>press and hold</color> the Dodge button to trigger <color=#FF6347>Divine Prayer</color> that grants DMG Reduction. While in <color=#FF6347>Divine Prayer</color>, it is allowed to ping 2 sets of orbs. The orbs pinged during the prayer will amplify it and increase the base multiplier. Each time orbs are pinged, triggers <color=#FF6347>Prayer Ripple</color> that deals Fire DMG to enemies, imprisons them, and heals allies. When <color=#FF6347>Core Passive - Ode for Everlight</color> reaches Lv.22, entering <color=#FF6347>Divine Prayer</color> will grant <color=#FF6347>1</color> random Signal Orb, and casting Oaths will restore Dodge Energy.
SpecificDes[1]:
Basic Attacks and pinging orbs accumulate Prayer. When it is full, <color=#FF6347>press and hold</color> the Dodge button to trigger <color=#FF6347>Divine Prayer</color> that grants DMG Reduction. While in <color=#FF6347>Divine Prayer</color>, it is allowed to ping 2 sets of orbs. The orbs pinged during the prayer will amplify it and increase the base multiplier. Each time orbs are pinged, triggers <color=#FF6347>Prayer Ripple</color> that deals Fire DMG to enemies, imprisons them, and heals allies. When <color=#FF6347>Core Passive - Ode for Everlight</color> reaches Lv.22, entering <color=#FF6347>Divine Prayer</color> will grant <color=#FF6347>1</color> random Signal Orb, and casting Oaths will restore Dodge Energy.
- <color=#FF6347>Divine Prayer</color> grants <color=#FF6347>70%</color> DMG Reduction.
- During the prayer, <color=#FF6347>1/2/3</color>-Ping grants <color=#FF6347>1/2/4</color> stack(s) of amplification to the prayer, and each stack increases the base multiplier by <color=#FF6347>0.5</color>.
- <color=#FF6347>Prayer Ripple</color> deals <color=#FF6347>352.94%</color> Fire DMG to the enemies, imprisons them for <color=#FF6347>2</color>s, and heals allies for <color=#FF6347>7.5%</color> of their max HP.
- When <color=#FF6347>Core Passive - Ode for Everlight</color> reaches Lv.22, entering <color=#FF6347>Divine Prayer</color> will grant <color=#FF6347>1</color> random Signal Orb, and casting Oaths will restore <color=#FF6347>100</color> Dodge Energy.
Title[2]: Purity Oath: <color=#0d70bc>Divine Prayer + Same-colored 3-Pings</color>
BriefDes[2]: If both sets of Signal Orbs are of the same color, triggers <color=#FF6347>Purity Oath</color> that deals AOE Fire DMG.
SpecificDes[2]: If both sets of Signal Orbs are of the same color, triggers <color=#FF6347>Purity Oath</color> that deals AOE Fire DMG.\n- Deals <color=#FF6347>352.94%</color> Fire DMG.
Title[3]: Chaos Oath: <color=#0d70bc>Divine Prayer + Different-colored 3-Pings</color>
BriefDes[3]: If the two sets of Signal Orbs have different colors, triggers <color=#FF6347>Chaos Oath</color> that pulls enemies in an extremely large area, dealing Fire DMG to them and <color=#FF6347>a small amount of dodgeable DMG to Liv: Empyrea</color>.

BriefDes[1]: Press and hold Dodge or cast <color=#FF6347>Quantum Compression Shot</color>/<color=#FF6347>Flame Bombing</color> to trigger Nanami: Starfarer's Slide Mode, during which the above skills can be cast without intervals.
SpecificDes[1]: Press and hold Dodge or cast <color=#FF6347>Quantum Compression Shot</color>/<color=#FF6347>Flame Bombing</color> to trigger Nanami: Starfarer's Slide Mode, during which the above skills can be cast without intervals.
Title[2]: Bzzz Mode: <color=#0d70bc>"Rumbling" Mode + Cast Ironsoul Slice + Press and hold Basic Attack</color>
BriefDes[2]: When in the <color=#FF6347>"Rumbling" Mode</color>, Nanami: Starfarer will gain a Pressure Gauge. When <color=#FF6347>Ironsoul Slice</color> hits an enemy, press and hold Basic Attack to trigger the <color=#FF6347>"Bzzz" Mode</color>, during which releasing the Basic Attack button at different timings will trigger <color=#FF6347>"Oops! Missed it!"</color> or <color=#FF6347>"Perfect!"</color>.
SpecificDes[2]: When in the <color=#FF6347>"Rumbling" Mode</color>, Nanami: Starfarer will gain a Pressure Gauge. When <color=#FF6347>Ironsoul Slice</color> hits an enemy, press and hold Basic Attack to trigger the <color=#FF6347>"Bzzz" Mode</color>, during which releasing the Basic Attack button at different timings will trigger <color=#FF6347>"Oops! Missed it!"</color> or <color=#FF6347>"Perfect!"</color>.\n- The Pressure Gauge has a limit of <color=#FF6347>200</color>.
Title[3]: Oops! Missed it!: <color=#0d70bc>"Bzzz" Mode + Press and hold Basic Attack, then release when charging halfway</color>
BriefDes[3]: <color=#FF6347>"Oops! Missed it!"</color> will grant Pressure and Signature Energy, during which time Nanami will gain Super Armor and Extra DMG Reduction. The <color=#FF6347>"Oops! Missed it!"</color> variants triggered from <color=#FF6347>Ironsoul Slice I</color>, <color=#FF6347>Ironsoul Slice II</color>, and <color=#FF6347>Ironsoul Slice III</color> all deal Fire DMG.
SpecificDes[3]:
<color=#FF6347>"Oops! Missed it!"</color> will grant Pressure and Signature Energy, during which time Nanami will gain Super Armor and Extra DMG Reduction. The <color=#FF6347>"Oops! Missed it!"</color> variants triggered from <color=#FF6347>Ironsoul Slice I, II, III</color> all deal Fire DMG.
- <color=#FF6347>"Oops! Missed it!"</color> grants <color=#FF6347>80</color> Pressure and <color=#FF6347>32</color> Signature Energy.
- When casting <color=#FF6347>"Oops! Missed it!"</color>, Nanami: Starfarer gains Super Armor and <color=#FF6347>50%</color> Extra DMG Reduction.
- The <color=#FF6347>"Oops! Missed it!"</color> of <color=#FF6347>Ironsoul Slice I</color> deals <color=#FF6347>182.35%</color> Fire DMG.
- The <color=#FF6347>"Oops! Missed it!"</color> of <color=#FF6347>Ironsoul Slice II</color> deals <color=#FF6347>273.53%</color> Fire DMG.
- The <color=#FF6347>"Oops! Missed it!"</color> of <color=#FF6347>Ironsoul Slice III</color> deals <color=#FF6347>364.71%</color> Fire DMG.
Title[4]: Perfect!: <color=#0d70bc>"Bzzz" Mode + Press and hold Basic Attack, then release when charging more than halfway</color>
BriefDes[4]: <color=#FF6347>"Perfect!"</color> will grant Pressure and Signature Energy, during which time Nanami will gain Super Armor and Extra DMG Reduction. The <color=#FF6347>"Perfect!"</color> variants triggered from <color=#FF6347>Ironsoul Slice I</color>, <color=#FF6347>Ironsoul Slice II</color>, and <color=#FF6347>Ironsoul Slice III</color> all deal Fire DMG.
SpecificDes[4]:
<color=#FF6347>"Perfect!"</color> will grant Pressure and Signature Energy, during which time Nanami will gain Super Armor and Extra DMG Reduction. The <color=#FF6347>"Perfect!"</color> variants triggered from <color=#FF6347>Ironsoul Slice I, II, III</color> all deal Fire DMG.
- <color=#FF6347>"Perfect!"</color> grants <color=#FF6347>120</color> Pressure and <color=#FF6347>48</color> Signature Energy.
- When casting <color=#FF6347>"Perfect!"</color>, Nanami: Starfarer gains Super Armor and <color=#FF6347>50%</color> Extra DMG Reduction.
- The <color=#FF6347>"Perfect!"</color> of <color=#FF6347>Ironsoul Slice I</color> deals <color=#FF6347>273.53%</color> Fire DMG.
- The <color=#FF6347>"Perfect!"</color> of <color=#FF6347>Ironsoul Slice II</color> deals <color=#FF6347>364.71%</color> Fire DMG.
- The <color=#FF6347>"Perfect!"</color> of <color=#FF6347>Ironsoul Slice III</color> deals <color=#FF6347>638.24%</color> Fire DMG.
Title[5]: Burning Blow: <color=#0d70bc>At least 200 Pressure + "Bzzz" Mode + Press and hold Basic Attack, then release when charging to the limit</color>
BriefDes[5]: When there is enough Pressure, press and hold Basic Attack to the limit to consume all Pressure and cast <color=#FF6347>Burning Blow</color> to restore Signature Energy and grant the damage multiplier of <color=#FF6347>"Perfect!"</color> plus a DMG Bonus based on the Pressure consumed to the corresponding <color=#FF6347>Ironsoul Slice</color>. The Base DMG of this skill is increased based on the amount of Pressure consumed. Once the total damage is calculated, it will be recorded. When Nanami: Starfarer casts <color=#FF6347>Gigabyte Star Strike</color>, she will become temporarily invincible and deal a portion of the recorded damage again, after which the record will be reset.
SpecificDes[5]:
When there is enough Pressure, press and hold Basic Attack to the limit to consume all Pressure and cast <color=#FF6347>Burning Blow</color> to restore Signature Energy and grant the damage multiplier of <color=#FF6347>"Perfect!"</color> plus a DMG Bonus based on the Pressure consumed to the corresponding <color=#FF6347>Ironsoul Slice</color>. The Base DMG of this skill is increased based on the amount of Pressure consumed. Once the total damage is calculated, it will be recorded. When Nanami: Starfarer casts <color=#FF6347>Gigabyte Star Strike</color>, she will become temporarily invincible and deal a portion of the recorded damage again, after which the record will be reset.
- <color=#FF6347>Burning Blow</color> can be cast when there is at least <color=#FF6347>200</color> Pressure.
- Casting <color=#FF6347>Burning Blow</color> will restore <color=#FF6347>60</color> Signature Energy.
- <color=#FF6347>Burning Blow</color> grants the damage multiplier of <color=#FF6347>"Perfect!"</color> plus a DMG Bonus based on the Pressure consumed to the corresponding <color=#FF6347>Ironsoul Slice</color>. Its Base DMG increases by <color=#FF6347>0.25%</color> for every point of Pressure consumed.
- Casting <color=#FF6347>Gigabyte Star Strike</color> will deal <color=#FF6347>50%</color> of the recorded damage again, after which the record will be reset.
Title[6]: Mirage Flash: <color=#0d70bc>"Bzzz" Mode + Release Basic Attack + Successful Dodge</color>
BriefDes[6]: Nanami: Starfarer is able to dodge incoming attacks during a brief period when she starts to cast <color=#FF6347>"Oops! Missed it!"</color> and <color=#FF6347>"Perfect!"</color>. Upon a successful dodge, she will cast <color=#FF6347>Mirage Flash</color>, dealing Fire DMG and generating Pressure.
SpecificDes[6]: Nanami: Starfarer is able to dodge incoming attacks during a brief period when she starts to cast <color=#FF6347>Oops! Missed it!"</color> and <color=#FF6347>"Perfect!""</color>. Upon a successful dodge, she will cast <color=#FF6347>Mirage Flash</color>, dealing Fire DMG and generating Pressure.\n- Deals <color=#FF6347>638.24%</color> AOE Fire DMG.\n- Generates <color=#FF6347>40</color> Pressure upon a successful Mirage Flash.

Release Dodge when <color=#FF6347>Bitterfrost Level</color> is fully charged to release <color=#FF6347>Bitter Frost</color>, dealing Ice DMG. Releasing Dodge before fully charged will result in no attacks, and <color=#FF6347>Bitterfrost Level</color> will gradually decrease. Getting hit while charging will deduct Dodge Gauge and performs Flash if there is enough Dodge Gauge available. Gains Super Armor and bonus Extra DMG Reduction when <color=#FF6347>Bitterfrost Level</color> is activated.

Name: Space Walk
Title[1]: Leap Attack: <color=#0d70bc>3-Ping available + Press and hold Basic Attack</color>
BriefDes[1]: When Karenina: Scire has at least a set of 3-Ping Orbs among up to 8 Signal Orbs, holding the Basic Attack button will start charging and consume 3-Ping Orbs (up to 2 sets can be consumed), each set granting Anti-gravity Energy. While charging, Karenina cannot dodge but gains Super Armor and Extra DMG Reduction. After that, Karenina leaps up into the air with <color=#FF6347>Leap Attack</color> that deals Dark DMG (its Base DMG increases if 2 sets of 3-Ping Orbs have been consumed) and activates the Anti-gravity status. When Karenina enters Matrix, holding the Basic Attack button will start charging and automatically consume Matrix's orb pinging effect (which is considered to consume a set of 3-Ping Orbs).
SpecificDes[1]:
When Karenina: Scire has at least a set of 3-Ping Orbs among up to 8 Signal Orbs, holding the Basic Attack button will start charging and consume 3-Ping Orbs (up to 2 sets can be consumed), each set granting Anti-gravity Energy. While charging, Karenina cannot dodge but gains Super Armor and Extra DMG Reduction. After that, Karenina leaps up into the air with <color=#FF6347>Leap Attack</color> that deals Dark DMG (its Base DMG increases if 2 sets of 3-Ping Orbs have been consumed) and activates the Anti-gravity status. When Karenina enters Matrix, holding the Basic Attack button will start charging and automatically consume Matrix's orb pinging effect (which is considered to consume a set of 3-Ping Orbs).
- Every set of 3-Ping Orbs consumed grants <color=#FF6347>20</color> Anti-gravity Energy.
- While charging, gains <color=#FF6347>50/80/90%</color> Extra DMG Reduction based on the number of 3-Pings made.
- Deals <color=#FF6347>225%</color> Dark DMG when leaping into the air.
- When two sets of 3-Ping Orbs are consumed during the charging, the <color=#FF6347>Leap Attack</color> will deal <color=#FF6347>200%</color> more Base DMG.
Title[2]: Anti-gravity Status: <color=#0d70bc>Cast Leap Attack</color>
BriefDes[2]: Gains Super Armor and Extra DMG Reduction while in the Anti-gravity status.
SpecificDes[2]: Gains Super Armor and <color=#FF6347>50%</color> Extra DMG Reduction while in the Anti-gravity status.
Title[3]: Radiant Whirlwind: <color=#0d70bc>Character is airborne + Tap Basic Attack repeatedly</color>
BriefDes[3]: While in the Anti-gravity status, tapping the Basic Attack button repeatedly will cast <color=#FF6347>Radiant Whirlwind</color> that deals Dark DMG (each Basic Attack increases Karenina: Scire's airborne duration and spin speed).
SpecificDes[3]: While in the Anti-gravity status, tapping the Basic Attack button repeatedly will cast <color=#FF6347>Radiant Whirlwind</color> that deals Dark DMG (each Basic Attack increases Karenina: Scire's airborne duration and spin speed).\n- Deals <color=#FF6347>5%</color> Dark DMG.
Title[4]: Gravity Overload: <color=#0d70bc>Triggered when character lands</color>
BriefDes[4]: Upon landing, <color=#FF6347>Gravity Overload</color> will be triggered to grant Signature Energy and deal Dark DMG. If Karenina: Scire has sufficient Anti-gravity Energy, she will automatically leap up into the air again by consuming certain Anti-gravity Energy. Once Anti-gravity Energy is insufficient, she will exit the Anti-gravity status with empty Anti-gravity Energy.
SpecificDes[4]:
Upon landing, <color=#FF6347>Gravity Overload</color> will be triggered to grant Signature Energy and deal Dark DMG. If Karenina: Scire has sufficient Anti-gravity Energy, she will automatically leap up into the air again by consuming certain Anti-gravity Energy. Once Anti-gravity Energy is insufficient, she will exit the Anti-gravity status with empty Anti-gravity Energy.
- Triggering <color=#FF6347>Gravity Overload</color> grants <color=#FF6347>20</color> Signature Energy.
- Deals <color=#FF6347>150%</color> Dark DMG.
- When there is no less than <color=#FF6347>20</color> Anti-gravity Energy, Karenina: Scire will automatically leap up into the air again by consuming <color=#FF6347>20</color> Anti-gravity Energy.
Title[5]: Kinetic Energy: <color=#0d70bc>Automatically accumulated when casting Radiant Whirlwind/Basic Attack speed-up</color>
BriefDes[5]: Each <color=#FF6347>Radiant Whirlwind</color> cast and Basic Attack speed-up will grant Kinetic Energy. Casting <color=#FF6347>Starshatter Horizon</color> will consume all the Kinetic Energy with each point consumed granting bonus Base DMG.
SpecificDes[5]:
Each <color=#FF6347>Radiant Whirlwind</color> cast and Basic Attack speed-up will grant Kinetic Energy. Casting <color=#FF6347>Starshatter Horizon</color> will consume all the Kinetic Energy with each point consumed granting bonus Base DMG.
- Every <color=#FF6347>Radiant Whirlwind</color> cast grants <color=#FF6347>7</color> Kinetic Energy.
- Every Basic Attack speed-up grants <color=#FF6347>21</color> Kinetic Energy.
- The limit of Kinetic Energy is <color=#FF6347>999</color>.
- Casting <color=#FF6347>Starshatter Horizon</color> will consume all the Kinetic Energy with each point consumed granting <color=#FF6347>0.12%</color> more Base DMG, up to <color=#FF6347>100%</color>.
BriefDes[6]: When the Anti-gravity status is activated, tapping Dodge casts <color=#FF6347>Airborne Spin</color> by consuming double Dodge Gauge to pull and knock nearby enemies into the air, dealing Dark DMG while restoring Anti-gravity Energy and Signature Energy. Upon a successful dodge, <color=#FF6347>Returning Repulsion</color> will be cast to pull and knock nearby enemies into the air, dealing Dark DMG and restoring additional Dodge Gauge.
SpecificDes[6]:
When the Anti-gravity status is activated, tapping Dodge casts <color=#FF6347>Airborne Spin</color> by consuming double Dodge Gauge to pull and knock nearby enemies into the air, dealing Dark DMG while restoring Anti-gravity Energy and Signature Energy. Upon a successful dodge, <color=#FF6347>Returning Repulsion</color> will be cast to pull and knock nearby enemies into the air, dealing Dark DMG and restoring additional Dodge Gauge.
- Deals <color=#FF6347>100%</color> Dark DMG.
- Restores <color=#FF6347>20</color> Anti-gravity Energy and <color=#FF6347>20</color> Signature Energy (can be triggered once per 10s only).
- Deals <color=#FF6347>200%</color> Dark DMG.
- Restores additional <color=#FF6347>500</color> Dodge Gauge value (can be triggered once per 10s only).

Name: Space Walk
Title[1]: Leap Attack: <color=#0d70bc>3-Ping available + Press and hold Basic Attack</color>
BriefDes[1]: When Karenina: Scire has at least a set of 3-Ping Orbs among up to 8 Signal Orbs, holding the Basic Attack button will start charging and consume 3-Ping Orbs (up to 2 sets can be consumed), each set granting Anti-gravity Energy. Name: Space Walk
Title[1]: Leap Attack: <color=#0d70bc>3-Ping available + Press and hold Basic Attack</color>
BriefDes[1]: When Karenina: Scire has at least a set of 3-Ping Orbs among up to 8 Signal Orbs, holding the Basic Attack button will start charging and consume 3-Ping Orbs (up to 2 sets can be consumed), each set granting Anti-gravity Energy. While charging, Karenina cannot dodge but gains Super Armor and Extra DMG Reduction. After that, Karenina leaps up into the air with <color=#FF6347>Leap Attack</color> that deals Dark DMG (its Base DMG increases if 2 sets of 3-Ping Orbs have been consumed) and activates the Anti-gravity status. Name: Rising Key
Title[1]: Charge Engine: <color=#0d70bc>Any 3-Ping + Tap Basic Attack repeatedly</color>
BriefDes[1]: After casting a 3-Ping, tap Basic Attack repeatedly to charge up the Rising Engine. When the tapping stops or goes over a certain period of time, Noan: Arca will perform <color=#FF6347>Gear-Break Combo</color> based on the color of Signal Orbs pinged, and its DMG will depend on the current <color=#FF6347>Gear Level</color>. Triggering a Combo Strike also consumes all <color=#FF6347>Rising Energy</color> charged to increase its DMG dealt. The <color=#FF6347>Rising Energy</color> consumed will be converted into <color=#FF6347>Rotational Speed</color>.

Each tap increases Base DMG by <color=#FF6347>15%</color>.
Title[2]: Gear-Break Combo: <color=#0d70bc>Tap Basic Attack repeatedly to trigger a Combo Strike</color>
BriefDes[2]: The next time <color=#FF6347>Gear-Break Combo</color> is triggered, if the current <color=#FF6347>Rising Energy</color> exceeds <color=#FF6347>Rotational Speed</color>, <color=#FF6347>Gear Level</color> will go up by 1.
SpecificDes[2]: The next time <color=#FF6347>Gear-Break Combo</color> is triggered, if the current <color=#FF6347>Rising Energy</color> exceeds <color=#FF6347>Rotational Speed</color>, <color=#FF6347>Gear Level</color> will go up by 1.
Title[3]: Assault-Rising Combo: <color=#0d70bc>Gear Lv.3 + Trigger Combo Strike</color>
BriefDes[3]: If <color=#FF6347>Gear-Break Combo</color> is triggered at Gear Lv.3, Noan: Arca will perform <color=#FF6347>Assault-Rising Combo</color> instead with an increased Extra DMG Bonus. <color=#FF6347>Rotational Speed</color> and <color=#FF6347>Gear Level</color> will be reset afterward.
SpecificDes[3]: If <color=#FF6347>Gear-Break Combo</color> is triggered at Gear Lv.3, Noan: Arca will perform <color=#FF6347>Assault-Rising Combo</color> instead with an increased Extra DMG Bonus. <color=#FF6347>Rotational Speed</color> and <color=#FF6347>Gear Level</color> will be reset afterward.\n- The Base DMG of <color=#FF6347>Assault-Rising Combo</color> increases by <color=#FF6347>50%</color>.

Gains Super Armor during <color=#FF6347>Sword Form</color>.

SpecificDes[2]:
While in <color=#FF6347>Hypermatrix</color>, tapping Basic Attack will trigger sniping attacks that deal Fire DMG, pull enemies, and return the Red and Yellow Signal Orbs pinged in the original worldline. If there are no Signal Orbs recorded, sniping attacks will generate Signal Orbs as Basic Attack does.
- Each sniping attack deals <color=#FF6347>100%</color> Fire DMG.
- The duration countdown of <color=#FF6347>Hypermatrix</color> will be paused when Lee is in his sniping mode.

Title[2]: Void Phantom: <color=#0d70bc>Press and hold Dodge to enter Phantom Realm</color>
BriefDes[2]: Press and hold Dodge to enter <color=#FF6347>Phantom Realm</color>, gaining <color=#FF6347>Blade Aura</color> over time. During this time, Alpha: Crimson Weave gets Super Armor and DMG Reduction, is unable to restore the Dodge Gauge, and enters the Parry Stance. Pinging Signal Orbs can also increase <color=#FF6347>Blade Aura</color>.
SpecificDes[2]:
Press and hold Dodge to enter <color=#FF6347>Phantom Realm</color>, gaining <color=#FF6347>Blade Aura</color> over time. During this time, Alpha: Crimson Weave gets Super Armor and <color=#FF6347>30%</color> DMG Reduction, is unable to restore the Dodge Gauge, and enters the Parry Stance. Pinging Signal Orbs can also increase <color=#FF6347>Blade Aura</color>.
- Restores <color=#FF6347>4 Blade Aura</color> every <color=#FF6347>0.1</color>s in the <color=#FF6347>Phantom Realm</color> Mode.
- Gains <color=#FF6347>10/20/40 Blade Aura</color> based on the number of the orbs pinged.
- <color=#FF6347>Blade Aura</color> Limit: <color=#FF6347>120</color>.
- When taking DMG in the Parry Stance, increases DMG Reduction to <color=#FF6347>70%</color>. Can block up to 3 times.
Title[3]: Munen Moment: <color=#0d70bc>Phantom Realm + Release Dodge</color>
BriefDes[3]: Press and hold Dodge to enter the <color=#FF6347>Phantom Realm</color>. Afterward, release Dodge to perform a powerful slash and deal Lightning DMG, during which Alpha gains Super Armor and DMG Reduction and is unable to restore the Dodge Gauge. Performing a powerful slash when <color=#FF6347>Blade Aura</color> is full will make Alpha Invincible, clear <color=#FF6347>Blade Aura</color>, activate <color=#FF6347>Munen Stance</color>, and restore Signature Energy.
SpecificDes[3]:
Press and hold Dodge to enter the <color=#FF6347>Phantom Realm</color>. Afterward, release Dodge at <color=#FF6347>0/60/120</color> <color=#FF6347>Blade Aura</color> to perform a powerful slash and deal Lightning DMG, during which Alpha gains Super Armor and <color=#FF6347>50%</color> DMG Reduction and is unable to restore the Dodge Gauge.
- When <color=#FF6347>holding the kodachi</color>, Alpha deals <color=#FF6347>25%</color>/<color=#FF6347>50%</color>/<color=#FF6347>200%</color> Lightning DMG.
- When <color=#FF6347>holding the odachi</color>, Alpha deals <color=#FF6347>55%</color>/<color=#FF6347>110%</color>/<color=#FF6347>440%</color> Lightning DMG.
- Performing a powerful slash when <color=#FF6347>Blade Aura</color> is full will make Alpha Invincible, clear <color=#FF6347>Blade Aura</color>, activate <color=#FF6347>Munen Stance</color>, and restore <color=#FF6347>25</color> Signature Energy.
- Alpha will automatically perform a powerful slash 1.5s after <color=#FF6347>Blade Aura</color> reaches the upper limit.
Title[4]: Lightless Points: <color=#0d70bc>Gained automatically when casting Signal Orb Skills/Dazzling Slash/Munen Moment</color>
BriefDes[4]: Gains <color=#FF6347>Lightless Points</color> every time when casting a Signal Orb Skill, <color=#FF6347>Dazzling Slash</color>, or <color=#FF6347>Munen Moment</color>. Casting <color=#FF6347>Eternaflare</color> will consume all <color=#FF6347>Lightless Points</color> to increase the Base DMG of <color=#FF6347>Eternaflare's</color> <color=#FF6347>Thunderous Slash</color> based on the <color=#FF6347>Lightless Points</color> consumed.
SpecificDes[4]:

Title[2]: Void Phantom: <color=#0d70bc>Press and hold Dodge to enter Phantom Realm</color>
BriefDes[2]: Press and hold Dodge to enter <color=#FF6347>Phantom Realm</color>, gaining <color=#FF6347>Blade Aura</color> over time. During this time, Alpha: Crimson Weave gets Super Armor and DMG Reduction, is unable to restore the Dodge Gauge, and enters the Parry Stance. Pinging Signal Orbs can also increase <color=#FF6347>Blade Aura</color>.
SpecificDes[2]:
Press and hold Dodge to enter <color=#FF6347>Phantom Realm</color>, gaining <color=#FF6347>Blade Aura</color> over time. During this time, Alpha: Crimson Weave gets Super Armor and <color=#FF6347>30%</color> DMG Reduction, is unable to restore the Dodge Gauge, and enters the Parry Stance. Pinging Signal Orbs can also increase <color=#FF6347>Blade Aura</color>.
- Restores <color=#FF6347>4 Blade Aura</color> every <color=#FF6347>0.1</color>s in the <color=#FF6347>Phantom Realm</color> Mode.
- Gains <color=#FF6347>10/20/40 Blade Aura</color> based on the number of the orbs pinged.
- <color=#FF6347>Blade Aura</color> Limit: <color=#FF6347>120</color>.
- When taking DMG in the Parry Stance, increases DMG Reduction to <color=#FF6347>70%</color>. Can block up to 3 times.
Title[3]: Munen Moment: <color=#0d70bc>Phantom Realm + Release Dodge</color>
BriefDes[3]: Press and hold Dodge to enter the <color=#FF6347>Phantom Realm</color>. Afterward, release Dodge to perform a powerful slash and deal Lightning DMG, during which Alpha gains Super Armor and DMG Reduction and is unable to restore the Dodge Gauge. Performing a powerful slash when <color=#FF6347>Blade Aura</color> is full will make Alpha Invincible, clear <color=#FF6347>Blade Aura</color>, activate <color=#FF6347>Munen Stance</color>, and restore Signature Energy.
SpecificDes[3]:
Press and hold Dodge to enter the <color=#FF6347>Phantom Realm</color>. Afterward, release Dodge at <color=#FF6347>0/60/120</color> <color=#FF6347>Blade Aura</color> to perform a powerful slash and deal Lightning DMG, during which Alpha gains Super Armor and <color=#FF6347>50%</color> DMG Reduction and is unable to restore the Dodge Gauge.
- When <color=#FF6347>holding the kodachi</color>, Alpha deals <color=#FF6347>30.88%</color>/<color=#FF6347>61.76%</color>/<color=#FF6347>247.06%</color> Lightning DMG.
- When <color=#FF6347>holding the odachi</color>, Alpha deals <color=#FF6347>67.94%</color>/<color=#FF6347>135.88%</color>/<color=#FF6347>543.53%</color> Lightning DMG.
- Performing a powerful slash when <color=#FF6347>Blade Aura</color> is full will make Alpha Invincible, clear <color=#FF6347>Blade Aura</color>, activate <color=#FF6347>Munen Stance</color>, and restore <color=#FF6347>25</color> Signature Energy.
- Alpha will automatically perform a powerful slash 1.5s after <color=#FF6347>Blade Aura</color> reaches the upper limit.
